statement: Two Skeleton constructors fetch-add the same 32-bit counter and store the returned old value at +0x0c.
Both Character::Actor construction paths call those Skeleton constructors.
Existing-key insertion returns without payload replacement.
A deferred cleanup path invalidates the wrapper before invoking the native virtual destructor.
Wrapper expiration clears W+0x18; Python method checks reject an expired native object.
Metadata resolver has a concrete adapter and name-based pending registration path.
Entity Transform and camera ViewMatrix getters return addresses, not a world-to-screen result.
